fields.name: start
fields.description: Start inference; set by i_start_req (hardware write) or firmware, cleared by firmware

fields.name: err
fields.description: Error flag; set by an illegal instruction or the PSLVERR pulse, cleared by writing 1

fields.name: done
fields.description: Inference done; set by firmware, drives o_sts_done

fields.name: busy
fields.description: Inference running; set and cleared by firmware

fields.name: label
fields.description: Predicted digit 0-9, written by firmware, drives o_result_label

fields.name: cnt
fields.description: Cycles from vector-instruction start to done, driven by m_vpu_perf

fields.name: busy
fields.description: 1 while a byte is being transmitted

fields.name: send
fields.description: Write 1 to send; m_uart clears it when it takes the byte

fields.name: baud_div
fields.description: Baud divisor in i_clk_core cycles per bit; provisional reset 0x06C8 (115200 baud at 200 MHz)

summary: The register map is unchanged. The spec changes (REQ-084 to REQ-087 and wording refinements) did not alter any register, offset, field, type or reset value. m_soc_csr is a single-clock APB4 slave (Asynchronous = 0) with six registers at the ASM-014 interim offsets: ctrl 0x00, sts 0x04, result 0x08, cycles 0x0C, uart_tx 0x10, uart_cfg 0x14. Types: ctrl.start rwi; sts.busy and sts.done rw (firmware-written, no hardware writer); sts.err w1c; result.label rw; cycles.cnt ro; uart_tx.data rw; uart_tx.send rwi (m_uart clears it); uart_tx.busy ro; uart_cfg.baud_div rw, reset 0x06C8 (1736). csr_check accepts the map. Integration: the two hardware sources of sts.err (illegal instruction and the m_apb_master o_sts_err_set pulse) must be ORed outside the CSR into the single i_hw_we_sts_err port, with i_hw_wdata_sts_err tied to 1. The generated port names differ from REF-003 (ASM-006).
